cases.title: Email accounts renders: stats tiles, inbox row (SMTP, warmup off), sender-identity card prompting setup
Sender identity: empty save is blocked with a message; valid save persists to the company profile (DB) and shows in the card; Cancel discards
Filters and search: Warmup On hides the (warmup-off) inbox, Warmup Off shows it, search by email narrows, no-match empty state
Warmup toggle on the row flips warmup_enabled in the DB and back
Detail drawer: Overview/Connection/Settings/Activity tabs render; Test sending sign-in against an unreachable SMTP host reports a clear failure
Settings tab: change daily limit / delay and Save Settings persists to DB; invalid value rejected
Connect Mailbox wizard: provider step -> SMTP form; validation for empty / invalid email and missing host
Connect SMTP mailbox with unreachable host: ends in a clear result (connected-unverified or explicit error), row appears iff created; no crash
Microsoft 365 connect button when MS365 is not configured shows a clear message (no redirect to undefined)
Alert Preferences modal opens, saves, closes; Run Warmup gives feedback
Delete mailbox: Cancel keeps it; Delete removes it (DB) and the row
Roles: MANAGER and AGENT cannot open Email accounts (redirect Home)
